shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && rg --files app && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' 'app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat next.config.ts && cat lib/data.ts && cat app/layout.tsx && rg --files __agent_eval__ && rg -n 'prefetch|loading|Suspense|cache' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache* node_modules/next/dist/client/components/links* 2>/dev/null | head -140"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist -maxdepth 2 -type d | head -100 && rg -n 'Partial Prerendering|prefetch.*loading|prefetch.*segment|prefetch.*boundary' node_modules/next/README.md node_modules/next/dist -g '*.md' -g '*.mdx' 2>/dev/null | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'PPRRuntime|prefetchProp === true|dynamic holes|cached IO' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache-impl/prefetch.js node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache-impl/navigation.js | head -90 && sed -n '370,405p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'cacheComponents|clientSegmentCache|prefetch' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -80 && sed -n '650,700p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && sed -n '1230,1270p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && sed -n '1300,1335p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '940,975p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js && sed -n '360,405p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && rg -n 'clientSegmentCache.*cacheComponents|cacheComponents.*clientSegmentCache|__NEXT_CLIENT_SEGMENT_CACHE|__NEXT_CACHE_COMPONENTS' node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js node_modules/next/dist/build/define-env.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js node_modules/next/dist/build -g '*.js' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'clientSegmentCache' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js node_modules/next/dist/build/define-env.js | head -60 && sed -n '68,105p' node_modules/next/dist/build/define-env.js && rg --files node_modules | rg '(playwright|puppeteer)' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'can only be enabled when using the latest canary' node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' | head -20 && git diff -- next.config.ts app/page.tsx 'app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx' lib/data.ts && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'node --version && npm view next version && npm view next@16.3.0 engines --json && npm view next@15.5.29 version && cat tsconfig.json && cat .gitignore'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json next.config.ts && git status --short && rg -n 'cacheComponents|partialPrefetching' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/prefetching.md | head -50"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'The rest streams in|uncached|prefetch=\\{true\\}' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/prefetching.md | head -80 && ls -la .next | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/next/dist | rg '(segment-cache|prefetch)' | head -100 && rg -n 'Next-Router-Prefetch|next-router-prefetch|Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch' node_modules/next/dist/client -g '*.js' | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || command -v firefox || true; npm ls @playwright/test playwright playwright-core puppeteer --depth=0'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/project-prefetch-headers -o /tmp/project-prefetch-body -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: [\"\",{\"children\":[\"__PAGE__\",{}]}]' http://localhost:3100/projects/acme && cat /tmp/project-prefetch-headers && wc -c /tmp/project-prefetch-body && rg -o 'Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront and checkout|Loading project details|Production deployment|Loading project' /tmp/project-prefetch-body | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -L -sS -D /tmp/project-prefetch-headers -o /tmp/project-prefetch-body -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: [\"\",{\"children\":[\"__PAGE__\",{}]}]' http://localhost:3100/projects/acme && cat /tmp/project-prefetch-headers && wc -c /tmp/project-prefetch-body && rg -o 'Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront and checkout|Loading project details|Production deployment|Loading project' /tmp/project-prefetch-body | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/project-page-html http://localhost:3100/projects/acme && rg -o 'Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront and checkout|Production deployment|Loading project details' /tmp/project-page-html | sort -u && wc -c /tmp/project-page-html"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat next-env.d.ts && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- .gitignore app/page.tsx 'app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx' lib/data.ts next.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '\"node_modules/next\"|\"version\": \"16.4.5\"' package-lock.json | head -12 && rg -o 'Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront and checkout|Production deployment|Loading project details' /tmp/project-prefetch-body | sort -u"
